# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Reference Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Methodology note**: This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge of Vietnamese government documents (Power Development Plans, EVN/PVN/Vinacomin reports), IEA, GEM (Global Energy Monitor), and industry sources available up to my knowledge cutoff (early 2025). Because I cannot browse the internet, **URLs are cited as known canonical addresses**; readers should verify current availability. Where two independent sources confirm a data point, both are listed. Gaps are marked **N/A** or **TBC**.

---

## Caveats & Limitations

1. Vietnam's **Power Development Plan 8 (PDP8)**, approved by Prime Minister Decision No. 500/QĐ-TTg on 15 May 2023, is the primary planning document for 2021–2030 with a vision to 2050. It supersedes PDP7 Revised (Decision 428/QĐ-TTg, 2016).
2. Unit capacities are **net MWe** where available; gross figures used where net is not published.
3. Several projects have changed status multiple times; the most recent confirmed status is shown.
4. "Domestic gas" refers to gas from Vietnamese offshore fields (Nam Con Son, PM3-CAA, Cuu Long, Block B, etc.). "Imported LNG" refers to regasified LNG at purpose-built terminals.
5. This table is **not exhaustive for every sub-30 MWe unit** at multi-unit stations; only units ≥30 MWe are counted toward totals.

---

## Abbreviations

|---|---|
| EVN | Electricity of Vietnam |
| PVN / PetroVietnam | Vietnam Oil and Gas Group |
| Vinacomin / TKV | Vietnam National Coal-Mineral Industries Group |
| BOT | Build-Operate-Transfer |
| IPP | Independent Power Producer |
| SC | Supercritical |
| USC | Ultra-Supercritical |
| SubC | Subcritical |
| CCGT | Combined Cycle Gas Turbine |
| OCGT | Open Cycle Gas Turbine |
| COD | Commercial Operation Date |
| PDP8 | Power Development Plan 8 (2023) |
| GEM | Global Energy Monitor (globalenergymonitor.org) |
| NLDC | National Load Dispatch Centre |

Several projects may be delayed beyond their PDP8 target dates.

> ⚠️ **Long Phu 1**: The Russian contractor Power Machines was sanctioned following the 2022 Ukraine invasion. Vietnam is seeking a replacement contractor; COD is highly uncertain.

> ⚠️ **Block B – Ô Môn Gas Pipeline**: The O Mon 2/3/4 CCGT plants are contingent on the Block B offshore gas development and the associated pipeline. As of early 2025, the Final Investment Decision (FID) for Block B had not been confirmed, creating uncertainty for these plants.

> ⚠️ **Coal Phase-Out Commitment**: Under Vietnam's COP26 commitment (JETP – Just Energy Transition Partnership, announced December 2022), Vietnam has committed to peak coal power by 2030 and phase out unabated coal by 2040. This may affect the status of post-2030 coal projects listed above.

> ⚠️ **Capacity figures**: Where official Vietnamese sources report gross MW and net MWe differ, gross figures may be used. Readers should consult plant-specific technical documentation for precise net output.
